title: Mediterranean Roast Chicken
description: A gluten-free, delicious roast chicken dish inspired by the Mediterranean region.
instructions: Rinse the chicken and pat dry with paper towels.
Mix together the mediterranean seasoning, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Rub the mixture all over the chicken, making sure to get some under the skin as well.
Drizzle the olive oil over the chicken and rub it in.
Stuff the lemon quarters and rosemary sprig into the chicken's cavity.
Place the chicken in a roasting pan and put it in the oven.
Roast the chicken for 45-50 minutes, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Let the chicken rest for 10-15 minutes before carving and serving.
